mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", code AS "code", endpoint AS "endpoint", protocol::text AS "protocol" FROM driver WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id

SELECT id AS "id", code AS "code", endpoint AS "endpoint", protocol::text AS "protocol", COALESCE(manifest->>'driver_kind', 'unknown') AS "driverKind" FROM driver WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id

SELECT d.id AS "driverId", d.code AS "code", d.endpoint AS "endpoint", d.protocol::text AS "protocol", di.id AS "instanceId", c.code AS "cap", dt.attr->>'device_model' AS "deviceModel" FROM driver d JOIN device_instance di ON di.driver_id = d.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device dt ON dt.id = di.device_id LEFT JOIN resource_capability rc ON rc.resource_id = di.resource_id LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = rc.capability_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{param1} AND d.status = 1 AND d.endpoint IS NOT NULL AND d.endpoint <> '' ORDER BY d.id, di.id
SELECT di.id AS "instanceId", c.code AS "cap" FROM device_instance di JOIN resource_capability rc ON rc.resource_id = di.resource_id JOIN capability c ON c.id = rc.capability_id
